hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Eastern Europe, bordering the Baltic Sea and Gulf of Finland, between Latvia and Russia || marshy, lowlands; flat in the north, hilly in the south || the mainland terrain is flat, boggy, and partly wooded; over 1,500 islands lie offshore || Resources: oil shale, peat, rare earth elements, phosphorite, clay, limestone, sand, dolomite, arable land, sea mud || Exports: cars, wood, broadcasting equipment, refined petroleum, prefabricated buildings (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: marshy, lowlands; flat in the north, hilly in the south || Eastern Europe, bordering the Baltic Sea and Gulf of Finland, between Latvia and Russia

climate.excerpt: maritime; wet, moderate winters, cool summers || sometimes flooding occurs in the spring

economy.excerpt: high-income, service-based EU and eurozone economy; rebound in exports playing a role in economic recovery; rising food prices contributing to inflation; decrease in labor force participation and rising unemployment rate; recovery depends on boosting private investment and productivity rates || Exports: cars, wood, broadcasting equipment, refined petroleum, prefabricated buildings (2023) || Industries: food, engineering, electronics, wood and wood products, textiles; information technology, telecommunications
